1.d4 d6 2.c4 e5.strategy: Strikes at the centre at once, with the d6-pawn supporting the push, instead of waiting behind White's pawns. Black prefers a direct fight to a cramped game: White has to settle the tension in the centre, and Black gets a share of the space and open lines for the pieces.
1.d4 d6 2.c4 e5.name: Rat Defence: English Rat

1.d4 d6 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5.strategy: Takes the pawn, but Black's d-pawn can simply take it back, so the move settles the centre rather than wins material. White heads for a quiet, simplified game in which the c4 pawn keeps d5 under control. Black must decide between recapturing at once and playing for more activity.
